question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints (huggingface.co resolve-redirect GGUF; llama.cpp constrained decoding; CPU-only nproc=4; no credential; no paid endpoint), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion (click #reveal-btn, then answer TARGET-42) for the obtainable credential-free model set {M-0.5B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN, M-LLAMA-3.2-3B (architecture-diversity probe)} -- and if not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across the credential-free endpoints actually available to the factory {E-LOCAL-LLAMA; E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI carried negative}? Return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation for readiness condition (3).
hypothesis: The parent 0/5 negatives for M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN are caused at least partly by system-prompt underspecification (audit VF-01), not by an immutable capability ceiling. Under PR-SPECIFIED (the frozen parent system prompt augmented by exactly the action-schema enumeration and the goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.'), the models' step-0 reveal-click (observed 5/5 in the parent) converts into a full click-then-answer completion: at least one candidate in the obtainable set {M-0.5B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} clears the bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5-episode arm), with all other constraints byte-identical to the parent (same GBNF, user template, task HTML, seeds 42-46, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, same shards, CPU-only).
falsifier: Under the same constraints with PR-SPECIFIED, no model in the obtainable set {M-0.5B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} measured under the frozen protocol clears the bar, while CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION confirms behavioral continuity with the parent (0/5 + reveal-click loop on M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN under PR-UNDERSPEC) and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE confirms the task/verifier rewards a correct click-then-answer (5/5). Exhaustion of the obtainable credential-free model range under identical frozen constraints, together with the carried endpoint-layer negative B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY, closes the credential-free external-agent path and licenses the explicit close/re-scope decision that readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfied: the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark must be re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3's same-model external anchor; re-anchor on internally re-run comparators on a task bank with demonstrable dynamic range, since readiness condition (2) is also open per the mandate's B2).

M-14B-QWEN joins iff all 3 shards download with pinned content-lengths AND available RAM >= 11 GiB at load time; otherwise it is recorded NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET (reason RAM or PROVISIONING) and excluded by this pre-declared definition. Qwen2.5-32B Q4_K_M (~18.49 GiB across 5 shards; first shard 3,961,498,272 B, HTTP-verified at DESIGN) and 72B exceed runner RAM and are NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET by the same definition; the E-LOCAL-LLAMA runnable Q4_K_M range ends at 14B.
model_set.architecture_probe_scope: M-LLAMA-3.2-3B is measured as a bounded cross-architecture probe (same ~3B size class as M-3B-QWEN) to separate a Qwen-specific ceiling from a small-model ceiling. It is gated on the frozen llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 runtime exposing a usable chat template (chat_format 'llama-3'); if the template cannot be constructed it is recorded NOT_MEASURED-RUNTIME, NOT a capability negative. Its result is reported as generalization evidence and does NOT gate the primary SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES branch.
model_set.reachable_but_not_measured_reason: Verified HTTP-reachable at DESIGN via the same huggingface.co resolve route (content-lengths recorded in measurement_validity). baselines.description: Parent numbers under PR-UNDERSPEC (EXP-INTEL-37982024058): M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN both task_success_rate 0/5, parseable_action_rate_step1 1.0, PC 10/10. External comparator for the treatment; re-anchored in-experiment by CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION on the same harness/conditions.
baselines.expected_outcome: Replication expected to reproduce 0/5 task success + step-0 reveal-click loop on both models

baselines.description: Per-step uniform random action (the TRUE parent semantics: harness_config.random_baseline.action_space of 5 entries; make_random_producer draws rng.choice() at every step), drawn from [click #reveal-btn; answer TARGET-41; answer TARGET-42; answer TARGET-43; answer unknown], max_steps=5, base_seed=42. FIXES the parent implementation bug by navigating to the loaded task page before every episode (parent ran this control on about:blank). Analytical chance: with q=P(click)=1/5, an episode succeeds iff the first non-click action drawn is the TARGET-42 answer, giving per-episode P(success)=r/(1-q)=(1/5)/(4/5)=0.25, hence P(clearing the >=3/5 bar by chance)~=0.104. The realized value with the frozen seeds is reported as the empirical chance floor.
baselines.expected_outcome: Chance-consistent: valid JSON 5/5; task_success_rate near the ~0.25 per-episode chance level, and the run either does or does not clear the bar - recorded as the realized chance floor, never used to inflate a treatment claim.

baselines.description: Deterministic policy that emits {'action':'answer','text':'TARGET-42'} on the loaded page WITHOUT ever clicking #reveal-btn, 5 episodes. Because success requires clicked_reveal==True, P(task success)==0 deterministically while parseable_action_rate_step1==1.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL - 0/5 task success, 5/5 parseable (isolates 'answer text alone is insufficient without the reveal click').

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-Q4_K_M from EXP-INTEL-37973264582 Gate 2: emits prose under UNCONSTRAINED decoding, 0% parseable. Contextual only; does NOT determine M-0.5B-QWEN's outcome under this experiment's frozen GBNF protocol.

PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.description: A deterministic NON-MODEL scripted policy emits at step 1 {'action':'click','selector':'#reveal-btn'} and at step 2 {'action':'answer','text':'TARGET-42'}, through the identical episode pipeline (same page server, Playwright/chrome, parser, verifier), on the loaded page. 5 episodes. Certifies the ceiling (a correct multi-step sequence is rewarded at 1.0), which no grammar-only control can do.
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.success_criterion: scripted_oracle_task_success_rate == 5/5. Any value < 5/5 => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the task/verifier cannot reward a correct click-then-answer; no candidate negative would be interpretable).
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.why_it_is_a_real_control: It can fail (broken page server, Playwright binding, click mechanics or verifier all yield < 5/5), separating task/verifier integrity from model capability.

PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.description: 10 probes 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' per candidate through the identical LlamaGrammar path used for episodes. Isolates model reasoning from decoding infrastructure.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid schema JSON per candidate, before any task episode of that candidate.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.why_it_is_a_real_control: It can fail (broken grammar/build does), separating decoding infrastructure from model capability; identical to the parent's passing control.

NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.description: Run the minimal task on the loaded page with a fixed invalid content producer ('I will click the button'), 5 episodes.
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.success_criterion: 0% parseable JSON actions and 0% task completion.
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.why: Confirms the verifier rejects non-parseable actions and that completion requires model-driven actions. Unlike the parent, this runs on the loaded page.

task_success_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with clicked_reveal=True AND revealed_value=='TARGET-42' AND final answer text == 'TARGET-42'

parseable_action_rate_step1.definition: fraction of episodes whose step-1 action parsed to valid schema JSON

answer_action_emission_rate.definition: fraction of episodes emitting >= 1 parseable 'answer' action (click-then-answer conversion metric)

step0_reveal_click_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with a click on '#reveal-btn' at step 1 (parent observed 5/5)

loop_signature_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with >= 1 post-reveal click on the now-hidden '#reveal-btn'

mean_inference_latency_s.definition: mean per-step inference latency per candidate

mean_completion_tokens.definition: mean per-step completion tokens per candidate

candidate_cleared_bar.definition: derived bool: parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6 over the 5-episode PR-SPECIFIED arm

obtainable_set_complete.definition: derived bool: every model in the pre-declared S_primary obtainable set was measured under PR-SPECIFIED (no NOT_MEASURED record)

NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.expected: 0 parseable / 0 success on the loaded page

B-RANDOM-ACTION.expected: chance-consistent (~0.25 per-episode success); realized value recorded
B-RANDOM-ACTION.failure_means: if it clears the >=0.6 bar, the 5-episode bar is too weak for this seed set and SUPPORTS requires task_success_rate>=0.8 for the clearing model

B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL.failure_means: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (verifier accepts an answer without the reveal click)

CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION.expected: 0/5 + reveal-click loop on M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN under PR-UNDERSPEC

measurement_validity: Task (frozen, identical to parent): synthetic page with #reveal-btn and a hidden #target div text TARGET-42, served via a local http.server on 127.0.0.1 random port. Success = click #reveal-btn (clicked_reveal=True, revealed_value==TARGET-42) THEN an answer action with text exactly 'TARGET-42'. The EXECUTE harness MUST navigate to the served task URL before EVERY episode (including all controls), fixing the parent about:blank control bug.

Parsing rule (frozen): an action must parse as JSON matching {"action":"click"|"answer", "selector"?:string, "text"?:string} with required click.selector / answer.text; any parse error, schema violation or missing field is a parse failure. Regex-parse fallback recorded as raw evidence only.

Constrained decoding (frozen): GBNF grammar from the parent fixture byte-for-byte; chat_format='qwen' for the Qwen candidates; llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 primary. The PyPI sdist was verified live at DESIGN (llama_cpp_python-0.2.90.tar.gz, 63,762,953 bytes); the identical source build already succeeded in the parent EXECUTE under this workflow. A 0.3.x wheel fallback is documented ONLY if the 0.2.90 build fails, gated by CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION continuity.
Sampling (frozen): temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, llama_seed=42, base_seed=42, episode seed = 42+episode_idx (5 episodes/arm/model), CPU-only nproc=4.

Treatment definition (frozen, single variable): PR-UNDERSPEC = the parent harness_config.json prompts.system literal VERBATIM = 'You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.'. PR-SPECIFIED = PR-UNDERSPEC + ' ' + 'Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<css selector>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.'. PR-SPECIFIED therefore differs from PR-UNDERSPEC ONLY by an appended schema enumeration and the goal sentence; the opening instruction sentence is byte-identical. The schema keys are written to match the frozen grammar (selector/text); the goal sentence is verbatim from the grand-parent census SYS literal (research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py). Leak guard (P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION): neither prompt contains '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42'. Component-wise isolation (schema-only vs goal-only) is out of scope for this packet and is recorded as a refinement for a possible follow-up, not as a missing control; comparing the bundle against its own no-goal/no-schema comparator is the preregistered single variable.

decision_rule:
Arms (frozen). Candidate order: M-7B-QWEN -> M-3B-QWEN -> (conditional) M-14B-QWEN -> (census-completeness) M-0.5B-QWEN -> (architecture-diversity probe) M-LLAMA-3.2-3B. Per candidate: PC-JSON (10/10) -> PR-UNDERSPEC (5 episodes; M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN = CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION; also for M-LLAMA-3.2-3B if measured) -> PR-SPECIFIED (5 episodes). M-14B-QWEN and M-0.5B-QWEN run PR-SPECIFIED only, after PC; their PR-SPECIFIED success is a capability result, and the prompt-conversion attribution rests on CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION for M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE runs once before any model episode. All controls navigate to the loaded task page before each episode.

Bar cleared iff parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6 over the 5-episode PR-SPECIFIED arm (>= 3/5 both; success mechanically requires clicked_reveal==True and exact answer TARGET-42). For SUPPORTS robustness, if the realized B-RANDOM-ACTION control clears the >=0.6 bar, the clearing model must then reach task_success_rate >= 0.8 to count as a proven driver (guards against the ~0.10 chance-clearing probability of the 5-episode bar).

Ordered evaluation (outcome in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MIXED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status in {COMPLETE, BLOCKED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}):
1. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE != 5/5 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL != 0/5 success => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION != 0 parseable => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-JSON fails on BOTH M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. A candidate whose PC-JSON fails is NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL (not a capability negative).
2. CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION PASS iff for EACH of M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN: task_success_rate == 0/5 AND step0_reveal_click_rate >= 0.8 AND loop_signature_rate >= 0.2 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.8. ANY unmet condition => REPLICATION-DEVIATION => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
3. SUPPORTS iff some model in S_primary clears the bar (with the B-RANDOM guard applied) under PR-SPECIFIED; record the driver id + shard hashes.
4. FALSIFIES iff PC/oracle/replication all PASS and EVERY model in S_primary is measured under PR-SPECIFIED and fails the bar. M-14B is either in S_primary and measured or excluded by the pre-declared availability definition, so S_primary is always fully measurable when downloads succeed.
5. MIXED iff at least one S_primary model is unresolved for a non-capability reason (download/shard/load/build/PC failure) while no model clears the bar.
The M-LLAMA-3.2-3B architecture probe is reported separately as generalization evidence and does not change steps 3-5.
claim_ceiling_rules: The result bounds capability ONLY for the frozen minimal two-step synthetic task, the frozen prompts, the frozen sampling and the measured credential-free candidates. SUPPORTS licenses readiness condition (3) for this task class with the recorded driver; FALSIFIES/MIXED bounds the credential-free driver set for this task class. No generalization to arbitrary multi-step web tasks; no Product-Core promotion; no claim-status change by this packet.

LARGEST-OBTAINABLE DEFINITION: the E-LOCAL-LLAMA runnable Q4_K_M range ends at 14B because 32B (~18.49 GiB) and 72B exceed the runner's ~16 GiB RAM; the 'largest obtainable' clause is satisfied by a pre-declared memory definition.
REPLICATION MIDDLE: CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION is all-or-nothing; any partial deviation => REPLICATION-DEVIATION => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (no undefined middle).
PROTOCOL-MISMATCHED NEGATIVE: M-0.5B-QWEN is measured under the frozen GBNF protocol (the census unconstrained result is a different protocol and does not transfer).

TREATMENT IDENTITY: PR-SPECIFIED is a strict append to the byte-identical PR-UNDERSPEC opening sentence, so the ablation changes only goal/schema presence - removing the prior-design confound where the opening instruction sentence also changed.

CONTROL VALIDITY: the parent ran NC and B-RANDOM on about:blank; this design runs every control on the loaded task page and adds the floor-exact B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL control; the realized B-RANDOM value and the ~0.10 chance-clearing probability are documented.

SCOPE HONESTY: non-Qwen GGUFs are HTTP-reachable and this is stated; one same-size cross-architecture probe (M-LLAMA-3.2-3B) is added, and the remaining reachable non-Qwen models are declared out of the bounded confirmatory scope.

PREREQUISITE HONESTY: the runner image ships chrome but not llama-cpp-python/playwright; both are pinned, PyPI-verified at DESIGN and were already built/run in the parent EXECUTE - a reproduced provisioning path, not an unproven assumption.
ARTIFACTS: freeze_artifacts lists the pre-existing mutable local inputs (incl. the treatment-provenance source min_webagent.py); the EXECUTE harness does not exist at freeze and is bound at EXECUTE.

CONTROL SENSITIVITY: NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (verifier rejects), B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL (answer without click fails) and B-RANDOM-ACTION (verifier does not accept chance) all exercise the same scoring path on the loaded page; PC-JSON and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE certify decoding and ceiling on that same path.
pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.no_outcome_claim: No confirmatory episode was executed and no model completion on the task was observed during DESIGN.

preregistration_timing: spec.json and prereg.md are written before any confirmatory episode is executed. DESIGN performed no outcome-bearing measurement: no model was loaded and no task episode was run.
product_consequence_positive: Readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven credential-free same-model driver (model id + shard hashes). The four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark becomes executable as frozen: same model/tools/budget across COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL, SPIDER arms on a task bank with dynamic range (readiness condition (2) remains separately owned). Intel hands Product/Graph a verified credential-free endpoint certificate (E-LOCAL-LLAMA + model receipt). C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL (DIRECTOR decision).
product_consequence_negative: Readiness condition (3) is demonstrated NOT satisfiable on the credential-free path up to the measured ceiling. C-LLM-INHERIT must be re-scoped: drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor; require internally re-run comparators (same harness, frozen seeds) on a task bank with demonstrable dynamic range (cold and retrieval must NOT saturate at 1.0 at high novelty, per the mandate's B2 and EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128). The close/re-scope recommendation is the deliverable for the Global Research Director; no promotion of any credential-free endpoint into Product Core is authorized by this experiment.
estimated_cost: Downloads: M-0.5B 491,400,032 B + M-3B 2,104,932,768 B + M-7B 4,683,073,632 B = 7.28 GB (6.78 GiB) baseline; +8.99 GB (8.37 GiB, M-14B) if escalation triggers; +2.02 GB (M-LLAMA-3.2-3B) if the architecture probe runs; ~18.3 GB worst case, all via huggingface.co resolve-redirect. llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 source build ~10-20 min; playwright wheel install <1 min. CPU-only (nproc=4) inference: 7B ~5-10 s/step, 3B ~2-5 s/step, 14B ~15-20 s/step, 0.5B <1 s/step; ~50-85 episode-equivalents incl. controls ~1.5-3 h. Total wall time ~2-4.5 h, within the 360-min workflow budget; zero monetary cost.
expected_information_gain: Decisive for readiness condition (3). It resolves the single open ambiguity named by the audit (VF-01): whether the parent's 0/5 is a prompt-underspecification artifact or an immutable capability ceiling for a minimal multi-step Web-agent task, and grounds the ceiling claim across the obtainable local models under the identical frozen protocol (fixing the census's unconstrained-0.5B protocol gap). Both directions change a program decision: SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm benchmark as frozen; FALSIFIES/MIXED closes the credential-free path with an explicit accountable re-scope and removes a three-claim bottleneck (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON). The within-experiment replication arm makes this an identifiability-safe ablation rather than a version-fragile re-run, and the corrected controls (loaded-page NC/B-RANDOM plus floor-exact B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL) repair the parent's invalid chance bound.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome branch is reachable from frozen, mechanically verifiable states (see pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.branch_reachability_matrix). SUPPORTS: any measured S_primary candidate clears under PR-SPECIFIED (completion verified mechanically). FALSIFIES: PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE 5/5, B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL 0/5, NC 0 parseable, replication PASS, and every S_primary candidate measured and failing; because M-14B is either in S_primary (and measured) or excluded by the pre-declared availability definition, S_primary is always fully measurable when downloads succeed, so FALSIFIES is reachable independently of the RAM gate. MIXED: an S_primary candidate is unresolved for a non-capability reason. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: scripted-oracle failure, B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL > 0, NC > 0, both-PC failure, replication deviation, or infra failure - all defined. Thresholds (>=3/5, and the conditional >=0.8 B-RANDOM guard) are arithmetically attainable (0..5 range). Precedence is acyclic: the oracle/null/PC/replication gates precede the capability verdict and never make a later branch unreachable for a valid run.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All hard prerequisites were verified live at DESIGN by non-outcome-bearing probes (pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.environment_probes). Already present in the runner image: python 3.12.15; gcc 13.3.0 / cmake 3.31.6 / GNU Make 4.3 (sufficient to build the llama-cpp-python sdist); Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 at /usr/bin/google-chrome (the browser binary, so no Playwright browser download is required); nproc=4; disk 85 GiB free; RAM 14,471 MiB available; live huggingface.co resolve-redirect for all pinned GGUFs. Provisioned at EXECUTE from public PyPI, pinned and verified to exist live at DESIGN: llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 sdist 63,762,953 B and playwright==1.63.0 manylinux wheel. This is not an unproven 'created during EXECUTE' step: the parent EXECUTE (EXP-INTEL-37982024058) already downloaded, built and ran the identical 0.2.90 + Playwright 1.63.0 stack, loaded the same 3B/7B shards and executed 5/5 episodes under this same workflow/runner image (raw/model_receipts.json, raw/provisioning_evidence.json). No credential, paid endpoint, GPU or new substrate is required.

baseline_identifiability.reason: PR-SPECIFIED vs PR-UNDERSPEC differ ONLY in the system-prompt string: PR-SPECIFIED is PR-UNDERSPEC plus an appended action-schema enumeration and the goal sentence, with the opening instruction sentence byte-identical. GBNF grammar, task HTML, user template, seeds (42-46), temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, model shards (byte-pinned), verifier and episode count are identical to the parent fixture (path+sha256). The comparator is re-anchored in-experiment by CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION (expected 0/5 + loop on both 7B and 3B), so drift fires an identifiable discontinuity. This is NOT a ceiling/floor situation: the parent already shows partial capability (step-1 reveal-click 5/5, parseable 1.0) so the arms are not guaranteed identical; B-RANDOM and B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL bound the chance/floor, and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE bounds the ceiling at 1.0. Cost metrics (mean_inference_latency_s, mean_completion_tokens) are recorded identically for both arms

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared expected value and failure meaning (control_registry) and runs through the same episode/scoring implementation on the loaded task page. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE must return 5/5 and can fail if the page/verifier is broken (certifies the ceiling at 1.0). PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING must return 10/10 and can fail on a broken grammar/build. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION must return 0 parseable/0 success (verifier rejects non-actions). B-ANSWER-NO-REVEAL must return 0/5 success with 5/5 parseable (the reveal click is required). B-RANDOM-ACTION must return chance-consistent success with valid JSON and can (rarely, ~10% over 5 episodes) clear the bar, which is why the guard exists. CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION must reproduce 0/5+loop and fires if the harness/environment drifts. No control is tautological or impossible.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment (PR-SPECIFIED) is a static system-prompt swap on the same executable path proven live in the parent: candidate GGUFs downloaded and served (7B/3B receipts; 14B/0.5B/Llama-3.2-3B URLs HTTP-verified at DESIGN), llama.cpp Llama + LlamaGrammar verified 10/10, Playwright 1.63.0 + chrome 154.0.8037.97 ran 5/5 episodes with verifiable click mechanics. The prompt is fully specified byte-for-byte in the frozen prereg and the EXECUTE harness constructs it from the frozen text with no discretion (the treatment is a literal string). PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE independently proves the task is passable end-to-end before expensive arms run. Reachability of M-14B-QWEN, M-0.5B-QWEN and the non-Qwen probe is HTTP-verified at DESIGN; their runtime loadability is gated to NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET / NOT_MEASURED-RUNTIME rather than assumed.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: freeze_artifacts lists every pre-existing mutable local input whose identity can change the interpretation: the reused parent fixture (task HTML + GBNF + PR-UNDERSPEC + user template + sampling), the ancestor EXECUTE harness (fork source + success mechanics + the control-navigation bug being fixed), the GGUF sha256 receipts, the census endpoint receipts, and the treatment-provenance source min_webagent.py (the SYS literal from which the PR-SPECIFIED goal/schema is derived). The freezer hashes them into freeze.json.artifact_hashes and they become immutable for this transaction. The only interpretation dependency not pre-existing is the EXECUTE harness and its derived fixture, which cannot be frozen because DESIGN writes only spec.json/prereg.md; they are bound at EXECUTE by sha256 into result.json.artifacts and provenance.json, and AUDIT re-verifies the derived fixture and both prompt strings byte-for-byte against the frozen prereg. Remote GGUF responses are pinned by URL + content-length + sha256 (recomputed at download) rather than by a pre-existing file hash.
